title: Crestline Summit Loyalty Program Award Chart
content:
Award tickets in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program are priced in miles per one-way passenger, by award zone and cabin, at one of two price levels: saver, and standard (any seat). The chart is the same at every Summit tier, from Summit Member to Summit Chairman.

### Saver award, miles per one-way passenger

| Award zone | Main | Premium Economy | First |
|---|---|---|---|
| Domestic | 12500 | 22500 | 25000 |
| Short-haul international | 15000 | 27500 | 30000 |
| Long-haul international | 30000 | 50000 | 70000 |

### Standard (any-seat) award, miles per one-way passenger

| Award zone | Main | Premium Economy | First |
|---|---|---|---|
| Domestic | 25000 | 40000 | 50000 |
| Short-haul international | 30000 | 47500 | 60000 |
| Long-haul international | 60000 | 85000 | 115000 |

Each figure is the price of one passenger travelling one way. Hypothetical reading: one passenger's one-way Premium Economy award in the short-haul international zone is 27500 miles at the saver level and 47500 miles at the standard level.
